references.text: Matt 24:24 also mentions the rise of false messiahs and false prophets who will perform great signs and wonders to deceive, even the elect if possible, which parallels the warning given in Mark 13:22.
Isa 13:6 warns of a time of great confusion and deception, which can be seen as a parallel to the warning about false messiahs and prophets in Mark 13:22.
Ezek 24:5 speaks of false prophets who mislead the people, echoing the theme of deception found in Mark 13:22.
Rev 13:13-14 describes how the false beast performs miracles to deceive people, reflecting the warning in Mark 13:22 about false signs and wonders.
Rev 16:14 mentions spirits of demons performing signs, which aligns with the warning about false signs and wonders in Mark 13:22.
Rev 19:20 speaks of the beast and the false prophet who performed miracles to deceive, directly corresponding to the warning in Mark 13:22.
